summary.zh: 用于浏览与介绍游戏作品的 Figma 交互原型。
summary.en: A Figma interactive prototype for browsing and presenting game projects.

website.zh: Vango 是一款用于浏览与介绍游戏作品的 Figma 交互原型。原型包含作品发现、分类筛选、详情浏览、搜索、评论、个人主页及内容发布等界面流程。
website.en: Vango is a Figma interactive prototype for discovering, browsing, and presenting game projects. It includes flows for discovery, filtering, project details, search, comments, user profiles, and content publishing.

full.zh: Vango 是一款用于浏览与介绍游戏作品的 Figma 交互原型。原型包含作品发现、分类筛选、详情浏览、搜索、评论、个人主页及内容发布等界面流程。
full.en: Vango is a Figma interactive prototype for discovering, browsing, and presenting game projects. It includes flows for discovery, filtering, project details, search, comments, user profiles, and content publishing.
